decisions.session_title: Settings page v2 implementation
decisions.title: Three scope calls locked in before Settings v2 coding started
decisions.intent: The agent surfaced three open questions from the plan doc before writing any code — Aviator-style intent capture, performed naturally.
options: Model field suggestions: aliases only vs aliases + full model IDs
Write-safety: single rolling backup vs timestamped history
Drift monitor: schema + docs only vs also watching CHANGELOG.md
decisions.chosen: Aliases only · single rolling backup (settings.json.karma-bak) · schema + docs only. All three recommended options, all three verifiable in the shipped code.
decisions.why_inferred: Keep v2 minimal and reversible; each rejected option adds surface area without proven need.

decisions.session_title: Feature research
decisions.title: Model project decisions as a ledger with supersedes-links, not a tree
decisions.intent: The original Feb/March idea was a "decision tree" for the dashboard, but tree visualizations collapse into hairballs as projects grow. Research into Aviator Verify showed their UI never draws a tree — it's one legible document per decision, listed chronologically.
options: Node-and-edge decision tree visualization
Chronological decision ledger with threaded supersedes-links
decisions.chosen: Ledger of decision cards, threaded like replies when a decision revisits an earlier one. The card you are reading is this decision's own first artifact.
decisions.why_inferred: Real decision history is mostly linear with occasional reversals; threading conveys descent without the layout problem. Lists scale with tools users already trust — chronology, search, filters.

decisions.session_title: Feature research
decisions.title: Hand-curate August as a static first draft before building extraction
decisions.intent: Prove the UI with real content before investing in an automated extraction pipeline. A month of this project's sessions, mined by hand into ~20 cards.
decisions.chosen: Static curated JSON served by a thin endpoint, rendered as a new Decisions tab on the project page. Automated (LLM-assisted) extraction comes only if the ledger earns its keep.
decisions.why_quoted: give me a first draft and then I can check it out all locally and then we can do changes to it as we go on
